card.name: Inside brand names and section cross-references
card.fires_on: Fires on a short piece partway through a capitalized brand name (V-ENC-LEXTA, ENS-AC-OVE), on the opening parenthesis before a section number in "[see ... (4.2)]" cross-references, and on a hyphen or capitalized word inside all-caps warning headings.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: Middle piece of an uppercase or split drug brand name, or a split word in an all-caps warning.
modes.example: Withhold, reduce the dose, or permanently discontinue ENS<<AC>>OVE based on severity.

modes.label: Section reference parenthesis
modes.description: Opening parenthesis after a section title in a see-also cross-reference, just before the section number.

modes.label: Heading hyphen or title word
modes.description: A hyphen inside an all-caps boxed warning heading, or a word inside a quoted title.
modes.example: WARNING: INCREASED MORTALITY IN ELDERLY PATIENTS WITH DEMENTIA<<->>RELATED PSYCHOSIS

card.writes: It pushes word starts like struct, pol, grid and strateg, with no clear link to the label text.
card.plain: It lights up at awkward break points inside brand names, headings and the bracket before a section number.
